player.title: Random combat keyword Auras follow their number
fixes: Keymaster Keenus, Shockwave447, Drone Interceptor and Drone Corvette: a Buff, a Nerf or becoming Radiant now adds or removes keywords to match the number on the card, keeping the ones it already has.
